About.title: Your trusted electronics & home store
About.subtitle: We make it easy to buy genuine electronics and home goods online — at wholesale prices, with delivery you can count on.
About.missionBody: Buying quality electronics and appliances in Cameroon often means uncertain prices, grey-market products and no warranty. AFRIMA fixes that: one clear price, genuine products, a real warranty, and delivery to your door — whether you order a single phone or a full carton for your shop.
About.value1Body: Wholesale and retail prices shown up front — no surprises at checkout.
About.value2Body: Sealed, original products with a manufacturer warranty on every order.
About.value3Body: Tracked delivery across Cameroon and the rest of Africa.
About.value4Body: A team you can reach 7 days a week, before and after your purchase.
